repository.name: @webex/calling

calling-client-sdk.summary: Published @webex/calling export (files: dist; declarations dist/types/index.d.ts). src/index.ts re-exports createClient, ICallingClient, CallingClientConfig, IceGatheringConfig, and CALLING_CLIENT_EVENT_KEYS. Declarations live in src/CallingClient/types.ts; behavior in src/CallingClient/docs/README.md. resolveCallingBackend and CALLING_BACKEND are shared exports from src/common, described in docs/architecture.md. The same barrel re-exports the package-wide shared surface (Logger, LOGGER, ERROR_LAYER, ERROR_TYPE, CallError, LineError, the event key enums and payload types from src/Events/types.ts, the src/common/types.ts exports, and the media-helpers re-exports), owned by the package architecture.

line-sdk.summary: Published @webex/calling export: ILine, LINE_EVENTS, and LINE_EVENT_KEYS re-exported from src/index.ts. Declarations live in src/CallingClient/line/types.ts; behavior in src/CallingClient/line/docs/README.md.

call-sdk.summary: Published @webex/calling export: ICall, TransferType, CALL_EVENT_KEYS, CallError, and the call detail types re-exported from src/index.ts. Declarations live in src/CallingClient/calling/types.ts; behavior in src/CallingClient/calling/docs/README.md.

call-history-sdk.summary: Published @webex/calling export: createCallHistoryClient, ICallHistory, and JanusResponseEvent re-exported from src/index.ts. Declarations live in src/CallHistory/types.ts; behavior in src/CallHistory/docs/README.md.

call-recording-sdk.summary: Published @webex/calling export: createCallRecordingClient, ICallRecording, getRemoteParty, and the recording request and response types re-exported from src/index.ts. Declarations live in src/CallRecording/types.ts; behavior in src/CallRecording/docs/README.md.

call-settings-sdk.summary: Published @webex/calling export: createCallSettingsClient, ICallSettings, CallForwardSetting, CallForwardAlwaysSetting, CallSettingResponse, ToggleSetting, and VoicemailSetting re-exported from src/index.ts. Declarations live in src/CallSettings/types.ts; behavior in src/CallSettings/docs/README.md.

contacts-sdk.summary: Published @webex/calling export: createContactsClient, IContacts, Contact, ContactResponse, and GroupType re-exported from src/index.ts. Declarations live in src/Contacts/types.ts; behavior in src/Contacts/docs/README.md.

voicemail-sdk.summary: Published @webex/calling export: createVoicemailClient, IVoicemail, SummaryInfo, and VoicemailResponseEvent re-exported from src/index.ts. Declarations live in src/Voicemail/types.ts; behavior in src/Voicemail/docs/README.md.

sdk-connector-sdk.summary: Published @webex/calling type export WDMDevice re-exported from src/index.ts. Declarations live in src/SDKConnector/types.ts; behavior in src/SDKConnector/docs/README.md.

registration-internal.summary: Internal registration contract used by Line and CallingClient: register, deregister, failover, failback, and keepalive over Mobius. Not exported from src/index.ts.

caller-id-internal.summary: Internal caller-identity resolver used by Call. Not exported from src/index.ts; the CallerIdDisplay event type is exported from src/Events/types.ts.

metrics-internal.summary: Internal MetricManager contract used by every calling module to submit calling metrics through the Webex metrics plugin. Not exported from src/index.ts.

sdk-connector-internal.summary: Internal singleton adapter contract (ISDKConnector) every module uses to reach the Webex SDK instance: request, services, credentials, device, and Mercury listeners.

mobius-socket-internal.summary: Internal MobiusSocket WebSocket client contract used by CallingClient for Mobius socket transport. Not exported from src/index.ts; disconnect event types are exported from src/Events/types.ts.

webex-sdk-host.source: Host WebexSDK instance (@webex/webex-core with internal device, services, mercury, metrics, and encryption plugins)
webex-sdk-host.summary: Authorized Webex SDK instance passed to every factory. The package reads webex.request, webex.internal.services, webex.credentials, webex.internal.device, webex.internal.mercury, webex.internal.metrics, and webex.internal.encryption through SDKConnector. Owned by the host application and the Webex JS SDK.

mobius-http.source: Webex Calling Mobius service (services catalog key mobius; getMobiusClusters)
mobius-http.summary: Mobius REST endpoints for device discovery, registration, keepalive, deregistration, and call signaling (ROAP offer/answer, call control). Owned by Webex Calling.

mobius-websocket.summary: Mobius WebSocket used by mobius-socket for request/response and asynchronous call events. Owned by Webex Calling.

mercury-events.summary: Mercury event stream through which Mobius call events, Janus call-session events, and recording events reach the package. Owned by the Webex platform.

janus-http.source: Webex Janus call-history service (services catalog key janus)
janus-http.summary: Call-history session list, read-state update, and delete endpoints. Owned by Webex.

userhub-recordings-http.source: Webex User Hub converged recordings service (services catalog USERHUB_SERVICE_NAME)
userhub-recordings-http.summary: Recording list, metadata, and delete endpoints. Owned by Webex.

hydra-http.source: Webex public API (services catalog key hydra)
hydra-http.summary: People, call-settings, and voicemail endpoints used for Webex Calling backends. Owned by Webex.

broadworks-http.source: BroadWorks XSI through the broadworksIdpProxy service
broadworks-http.summary: BroadWorks call-settings and voicemail endpoints used for the BroadWorks backend. Owned by Cisco BroadWorks.

ucm-gateway-http.source: UCM management gateway (services catalog key ucmgmt-gateway)
ucm-gateway-http.summary: UCM line and call-forward and voicemail endpoints used for the UCM backend. Owned by Cisco UCM.

contacts-service-http.source: Webex contacts service (services catalog key contactsService) and SCIM identity
contacts-service-http.summary: Contact and group CRUD and SCIM user lookup. Owned by Webex.

kms-encryption.summary: Key creation and encryption/decryption of contact and group fields. Owned by the Webex platform.

webex-metrics-plugin.summary: Behavioral metric submission used by MetricManager. Owned by the internal-plugin-metrics package.

internal-media-core.summary: WebRTC media connection and ROAP media engine used by Call. Owned by the Webex media team.

media-helpers.summary: Local microphone stream and noise-reduction effect re-exported by the package and consumed by Call. Owned by the media-helpers package.

webex-uc-config-http.source: Webex UC config API (/v1/uc/config on the Webex API host)
webex-uc-config-http.summary: UCM call-forward-always configuration read by the CallSettings UCM connector. Owned by Webex.

module_docs_decision.reason: The prior generator kept module specs in per-module ai-docs folders, which this migration retires. The repo-standards source-local default <module>/docs/README.md applies. tsconfig.json compiles TypeScript only, test:style lints src/**/*.ts, typedoc starts at src/api.ts, and package.json files publishes dist only, so Markdown under src/ enters neither the build output, the API docs, nor the npm tarball.

repo_context_decision.reason: Neither the operational context nor its schema existed in this package. The context is created from package evidence and the schema is copied byte for byte from the monorepo root .sdd/templates/repo-standards/schemas/repo-context.schema.json.

artifact_decisions.reason: Library package, not a deployable service: package.json has no start script, container, or deployment descriptor.
No package-level documentation site. build:docs writes typedoc output into the workspace docs/calling tree, which the workspace owns.

The package serves no HTTP routes. Mobius, Janus, User Hub, Hydra, BroadWorks, UCM, and contacts endpoints are external contracts owned by Webex and Cisco; the published surface is the npm export described by the *-sdk contracts.
No security policy file exists in this package. Security architecture is described in docs/architecture.md; the monorepo owns disclosure policy.
Contribution instructions are owned at the workspace root CONTRIBUTING.md.
CHANGELOG.md already exists and is maintained by the workspace release tooling; it is reused unchanged.
The CTO readiness checklist applies to deployable services. This package is a library.
No CTO checklist is created, so its schema is not needed.
